tools.name: score_deal
tools.description: Grade a car deal: compare asking price to expected market value. ZIP is optional. Same inputs/outputs as POST /api/score.

tools.name: explain_grade
tools.description: Explain the score_v2 rubric grade for a delta_pct. Same as POST /api/explain.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Service health, coverage, cache policy, and limitations. Same as GET /api/health.

description: Check a car dealer's quote. Returns a grade from A to F, the flagged fees and add-ons, and lines to send the dealer. Pass paste (the quote text), or selling_price and msrp. 3 free checks per UTC month. Same as POST /api/quote-check.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_quote · Public sink: score_deal, explain_grade, check_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_quote · Public sink: score_deal, explain_grade, check_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
